title: The Sinister Bead and the Great Brahma Prajna exposed
summary: Zhang Xiaofan breaks the Ghost King's formation at the sea, and the Ghost King's followers say the chance to take the Kui Ox is lost. In the fight the Sinister Bead on Xiaofan's stick is recognised as the Black-Hearted Old Man's treasure, and Xiaofan uses the Great Brahma Prajna, Tian Yin Temple's secret skill, in front of everyone. The Ghost King still swears to subdue the beast even at the cost of his life, while Bi Yao tries to reach Xiaofan and has to be held back. Afterwards Cang Song demands Xiaofan's death for colluding with the Demon Sect, Tian Buyi refuses to hand him over, and Tian Yin Temple's Fa Xiang and Fa Shan leave to report to their abbot. Xiaofan wakes after three days in an inn at Changhe near the East Sea; Lin Jingyu says he trusts him, but Dragon Head Peak disciples take Xiaofan away for questioning on Cang Song's order. Bi Yao wants to go to him, but You Ji stops her. The leaders of the four demon sects, including the Poison God, San Miao and Yu Yangzi, meet for the first time in a hundred years and swear to rise again.

flags: Subs call the bead the 'Blood-Striking Bead' and the founder 'Black Heart Elder': mapped to Sinister Bead and Black-Hearted Old Man. 'Brahman Prajna' = Great Brahma Prajna.

Large parts of the sea battle are wordless (70-110 s, 308-397 s): what exactly happens to the Kui Ox, and why Bi Yao is held back ('Bi Yao, don't go there!' 294 s, 'Witch!' 307 s), is not clear from the dialogue.
264 s 'In the entire Qingyun Sect, I'm only afraid of Wan Jianyi': a Demon Sect fighter, unnamed.
488-495 s: 'I'm the elder in charge. This item should be kept by me' is probably Cang Song taking Xiaofan's stick; the item is not named.
501-518 s 'Will you admit defeat?' looks like a childhood flashback/dream while Xiaofan is unconscious (the same scene recurs in EP25).
571-597 s: who objects to the arrest is not named; 'Tian. Let's go.' suggests Tian Ling'er.
833-842 s: San Miao addresses 'Master Ghost' = the Ghost King. 'Changsheng' sect = Longevity Hall. 'Hehuan Sect' = He Huan Sect.
Tian Ling'er and Song Daren listed from forms of address ('Tian', 'Song, lock the door'), not cards.
